# KIMS Nursery and Primary School (Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya), Selaiyur, Chennai

> KIMS is a Montessori school in Selaiyur, Chennai, India, for children from Pre-KG to Class 5, recognized by the Tamil Nadu Government. It is an initiative of The VEDIC Educational and Charitable Trust. Children learn every idea with hands-on Montessori materials so they understand rather than memorise, and the school builds "The 10 Superpowers of Learning", the human abilities that AI finds hardest to copy.

Every page below is also published as plain Markdown at the same address plus `index.html.md` (for example https://www.kimsindia.com/faq/index.html.md). The whole site in one file: https://www.kimsindia.com/llms-full.txt

## Key facts
- Official name: KIMS Nursery and Primary School. Also known as Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya, or KIMS Selaiyur.
- Recognition: Recognized by Tamil Nadu Government.
- Classes: Pre-KG, LKG and UKG (Montessori early years) and Classes 1 to 5 (Tamil Nadu State Board syllabus). Classes 6 to 12 are planned for children who come up through KIMS.
- Joining age: for Pre-KG, a child should have completed 3 years by 31 March of the year they join.
- School days and hours: Monday to Friday, and some Saturdays. Pre-KG 9:30 am to 12:30 pm; LKG and UKG 9:30 am to 2:30 pm; Classes 1 to 5 9:30 am to 3 pm.
- Method: Montessori, hands-on, concept-based learning; mixed-age early-years classrooms; English with Tamil and Hindi.
- Philosophy: The 10 Superpowers of Learning, created by Dr Sindu Sukumaran, D.Litt, Principal and Correspondent of KIMS and Founder & Chairman of The VEDIC Educational and Charitable Trust (founded 10 September 2015): The Explorer, The Detective, The Builder, The Maker, The Chameleon, The Teacher, The Superhero, The Time Traveler, The Shapeshifter, The Upgrader.
- Activities: Annual Day, Sports Day, festivals, family days, karate (trophies at the FCKA 2nd National Karate Championship) and the Science Olympiad Foundation's international Olympiads.
- Teaching children in Selaiyur since 2022.
- Address: KIMS, Avvai Nagar, Indira Nagar West Extension, Selaiyur, Chennai 600073, Tamil Nadu, India. Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvtjJJ6JbX8Po89R7
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98842 61592 and +91 73973 94336 (both on WhatsApp). Email: thevedic@gmail.com
- Admissions: admissions for 2026-27 are open for Pre-KG to Class 5. Start with the admission enquiry form at https://www.kimsindia.com/admission-enquiry/ or book a school visit at https://www.kimsindia.com/book-a-visit/ . Parents are welcome to visit and watch a class at work.
- Nearby areas served: Selaiyur, Camp Road, Rajakilpakkam, Madambakkam, Sembakkam, Chitlapakkam, East Tambaram, Tambaram, Medavakkam.

# AI can memorise anything. *Your child should understand.*

> KIMS (Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya) is a Montessori school in Selaiyur, Chennai, for Pre-KG to Class 5, recognized by the Tamil Nadu Government. Children learn concepts with their hands so they understand, not just memorise.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/

At KIMS in Selaiyur, children from Pre-KG to Class 5 learn every idea with their hands first, so they truly understand it.

## From first steps to Class 5, one way of learning

From Pre-KG to Class 5. Each stage builds on the last, like the Montessori red rods your child will one day line up from shortest to longest.

Early years · from age 3

### Pre-KG, LKG and UKG

Mixed-age Montessori classrooms where children learn through real materials: counting beads, movable letters, practical life.

- Reading and writing sentences by 5½
- English, with conversational Tamil and Hindi
- Maths up to 3-digit multiplication and division

Primary years

### Classes 1 and 2

The move from hands-on materials to abstract thinking, at the child's own pace.

- Tamil Nadu State Board: English, Maths, Science, Tamil, Hindi
- Computers as an extra subject
- Art, music and dance woven into lessons

Upper primary

### Classes 3 to 5

Deeper projects, field trips and stage work, so children explain what they know and not just repeat it.

- Tamil Nadu State Board syllabus
- Reports to parents twice a year
- A planned path on to Classes 6 to 12 at KIMS

## Memorised answers won't protect your child's future. Understanding will.

AI tools can already recite every answer in the textbook. The children who do well will be the ones who understand ideas well enough to use them.

### Learning by rote

- Learns the answer for the exam, forgets it after
- Stuck when the question is asked differently
- Competes with AI at what AI does best

### Learning at KIMS

- Touches, builds and tests the idea first
- Explains it in their own words
- Applies it to new problems with confidence

## The 10 Superpowers of Learning

Each one is a real part of human intelligence, the kind machines find hardest to copy. Every child at KIMS grows all ten.

1. **The Explorer** Tries lots of new things
2. **The Detective** Asks why and looks for clues
3. **The Builder** Picks the right tool for the job
4. **The Maker** Learns with hands, eyes and ears
5. **The Chameleon** Settles in fast to anything new
6. **The Teacher** Explains ideas to others
7. **The Superhero** Leads with kindness
8. **The Time Traveler** Thinks ahead before choosing
9. **The Shapeshifter** Switches between quiet focus and big ideas
10. **The Upgrader** Changes their mind and keeps growing

[How we teach them](https://www.kimsindia.com/philosophy/)

![A KIMS child smiling as she spins a Montessori globe](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/globe.webp)

## By the end of UKG, a KIMS child can…

- Speak fluently in English, and read and write sentences on their own
- Add and subtract with carrying, and work up to 3-digit multiplication and division
- Hold a simple conversation in Tamil and in Hindi
- Observe nature closely, describe it and try to explain why it happens

These are the Montessori curriculum goals at KIMS for the early years, Pre-KG to UKG.

# The 10 Superpowers of Learning

> How KIMS Nursery and Primary School in Selaiyur, Chennai teaches: ten learning superpowers that machines find hardest to copy, built through hands-on Montessori learning from Pre-KG to Class 5.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/philosophy/

The simple habits that help a child thrive in a fast-changing world, and love learning along the way.

Meet all ten · [Book a visit](https://www.kimsindia.com/book-a-visit/)

## The world is changing fast. These ten will last.

No one knows which jobs will exist when today's children grow up. Machines keep getting better at what we once taught for tests.

**What lasts is a child who can think, adapt and keep learning.** That is exactly what these ten superpowers build.

![KIMS children working on a Montessori map puzzle, seen from above](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/tour-map.webp)

## Every big leap has replaced one part of us

1. **Machines** Replaced our muscles 💪
   A single JCB shifts more earth in an hour than a hundred workers with spades.
2. **Computers** Replaced our sums 🧮
   One spreadsheet now does the counting that once filled a room with clerks.
3. **The internet** Replaced our reach 📚
   Any fact or person is a tap away: no trip to the library, nothing to memorise.
4. **AI · now** Makes thinking cheap 🧠
   It can answer, write and reason, and it roughly doubles in ability every 6 to 12 months.

### And every single time, no one could guess the new jobs.

1900s **Factory worker**

Today **Website designer**

1980s **Typist**

Today **App maker**

The 1900s factory worker never pictured a website designer. The 1980s typist never pictured an app maker.

So we've stopped trying to predict your child's job, and started preparing your child for any of them.

## Most of us use only a few. The future needs all ten.

Each superpower can be taught, and the best time to start is now. We wrap them in fun names and stories so children want to build them.

Most grown-ups today **1 to 3** superpowers we lean on

A KIMS child **All 10** grown together, from Pre-KG

## Ten superpowers, one confident learner

### The Explorer

Try lots of things first

A strong start comes from a wide mix of experiences: read widely, play new games, and ask plenty of questions.

**In class:** We celebrate children who try new things, even when they aren't the best at them yet.

> Say it to the childrenYour brain is a treasure map! Explore the whole island before you dig for the gold.

### The Detective

Look for clues and ask why

Don't just guess. Break a problem into small steps and think about why an answer is true.

**In class:** Children explain how they reached an answer, and practise arguing the other side too.

> Say it to the childrenBe a detective! Find the clues, think step by step, and always ask, "Why is this true?"

### The Builder

Use the right tools

Clever people work things out; effective people know which tool makes the job easier.

**In class:** Pencils, rulers, dictionaries and tablets aren't cheating. They help our brains do more.

> Say it to the childrenA master builder doesn't hammer with bare hands. Pick the right tool and your work gets stronger.

### The Maker

Learn with all your senses

We learn best using hands, eyes, ears and voice, not just reading and writing.

**In class:** Children act out events, build models, draw pictures, and present what they've learned.

> Say it to the childrenDon't just read about the rainforest: draw it, build it, and give a little talk about it!

### The Chameleon

Fit into new places fast

Step into a new game, class or subject and quickly work out the rules from a few examples.

**In class:** We mix up groups and activities so children learn to spot patterns and adapt.

> Say it to the childrenBe like a chameleon! In a new place, watch closely, spot the patterns, and blend right in.

### The Teacher

Teach it to learn it

You truly understand something when you can explain it simply to someone else.

**In class:** Children who master an idea teach it to a friend in just a few simple sentences.

> Say it to the childrenYou don't really know a secret until you can whisper it clearly to a friend.

### The Superhero

Lead with a good heart

A clever brain needs a kind heart: values that guide our choices when things get hard.

**In class:** Children write their own class rules, like "I choose kindness even when I'm frustrated."

> Say it to the childrenA smart brain is great, but a good heart is your real superpower.

### The Time Traveler

Think ahead

Picture what might happen next, so you can make a smart choice today.

**In class:** We play "What if?", pausing a story to ask what happens if a character chooses differently.

> Say it to the childrenTime-travel to tomorrow! What happens if you skip today's practice? Choose wisely now.

### The Shapeshifter

Bring the right mode

Different moments need different energy: quiet focus for reading, big ideas for brainstorming.

**In class:** We name the mode: "Scientist hats, quiet and watchful" or "Brainstorm hats, every idea welcome!"

> Say it to the childrenYou have many experts in your head. Tag in the Quiet Reader or the Curious Scientist for the job!

### The Upgrader

Keep growing

It's good to update old ideas and change your mind. That's your brain getting better.

**In class:** We treat mistakes as updates, and clap when someone says, "I used to think that. Now I know better."

> Say it to the childrenYour brain is like an app: it needs updates to stay quick and smart. Upgrading is a win!

## A Montessori classroom is built for superpowers

- ### Hands-on materials
  Bead chains, movable letters and puzzle maps. Every idea is touched before it is written.
  Maker
- ### Mixed-age early years
  Older children show younger ones how a material works, and learn it twice as well.
  Teacher Chameleon
- ### Free choice of work
  Children pick their next activity from open shelves and follow their curiosity.
  Explorer Shapeshifter
- ### Materials that show mistakes
  A piece that doesn't fit tells the child to look again, so they correct themselves.
  Detective Upgrader
- ### Grace and courtesy
  Waiting a turn, helping a friend, tidying up for the next child.
  Superhero
- ### Real tools, used well
  From child-sized brooms to dictionaries and computers in the primary years.
  Builder Time Traveler

Dr Sindu Sukumaran

D.Litt · Principal & Correspondent, KIMS

Founder & Chairman, The VEDIC Educational and Charitable Trust

## The mind behind the superpowers

The 10 Superpowers of Learning is the educational philosophy of Dr Sindu Sukumaran, D.Litt, Principal and Correspondent of KIMS. It is the purpose behind KIMS and the style in which every class is taught.

It works hand in hand with the Montessori method and with India's National Education Policy 2020, which calls for play- and activity-based learning in the early years.

**And above all, happiness.** A happy child is the surest sign that all their developmental needs are being met.

- English, தமிழ், हिन्दी
- Every festival, every faith
- Happiness first

## Don't worry about which job. Build the ten superpowers.

You don't need to guess your child's future career. Give them these ten superpowers and they'll be ready for whatever the world becomes, able to turn their hand to almost anything.

[Book a visit](https://www.kimsindia.com/book-a-visit/) · [See school life](https://www.kimsindia.com/events/)

# KIMS, in plain answers

> Answers about KIMS Nursery and Primary School (Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya), Selaiyur, Chennai: classes, Montessori method, recognition, admissions, location and contact.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/faq/

Everything a parent usually asks before a first visit. Still curious? Call **98842 61592** or **739 739 4336**.

### What is KIMS?

KIMS Nursery and Primary School, also known as **Kudos Indian Montessori Shikshalaya**, is a Montessori school in Selaiyur, Chennai, for children from Pre-KG to Class 5. It is recognized by the Tamil Nadu Government and is an initiative of The VEDIC Educational and Charitable Trust.

### Where is KIMS located?

KIMS, Avvai Nagar, Indira Nagar West Extension, Selaiyur, Chennai 600073. It is close to Camp Road, Rajakilpakkam, Madambakkam, Sembakkam, Chitlapakkam and East Tambaram. [Get directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pvtjJJ6JbX8Po89R7).

### Which classes does KIMS offer?

Pre-KG, LKG and UKG in Montessori early-years classrooms, and Classes 1 to 5, which follow the Tamil Nadu State Board syllabus. Classes 6 to 12 are planned for children who come up through KIMS. For Pre-KG, your child should have completed 3 years by 31 March of the year they join.

### What are the school hours?

Monday to Friday, and some Saturdays. Pre-KG: 9:30 am to 12:30 pm. LKG and UKG: 9:30 am to 2:30 pm. Classes 1 to 5: 9:30 am to 3 pm.

### How does KIMS teach?

Through the Montessori method: children learn each idea with hands-on materials before moving to the abstract, at their own pace. We build [ten learning superpowers](https://www.kimsindia.com/philosophy/), from curiosity and clear reasoning to kindness and a growth mindset, so children understand rather than memorise.

### What are the 10 Superpowers of Learning?

The educational philosophy of Dr Sindu Sukumaran, D.Litt, Principal and Correspondent of KIMS: The Explorer, The Detective, The Builder, The Maker, The Chameleon, The Teacher, The Superhero, The Time Traveler, The Shapeshifter and The Upgrader. Each is a real part of human intelligence that machines find hardest to copy. [See all ten](https://www.kimsindia.com/philosophy/#superpowers).

### Is KIMS recognized by the government?

Yes. KIMS Nursery and Primary School is recognized by the Tamil Nadu Government.

### Which languages do children learn?

English, with Tamil and Hindi. By the end of UKG, children aim to speak fluently in English and hold a simple conversation in Tamil and in Hindi.

### How do I apply for admission?

Fill in the [admission enquiry form](https://www.kimsindia.com/admission-enquiry/), or call or WhatsApp 98842 61592 or 739 739 4336. We arrange a visit to see a class, a short meeting with the teachers, and then confirm the admission.

### Can I visit the school first?

Yes, please do. Watching a class at work is the best way to judge a school. Call or WhatsApp 98842 61592 or 739 739 4336 to fix a time.

### What events and activities happen at KIMS?

An Annual Day on stage, a Sports Day, Grandparents', Mom's and Dad's Days, festivals such as Pongal, Deepavali, Christmas, Vinayaka Chaturthi and Onam, Independence Day, colour days for the youngest children, field trips, and karate, where KIMS students won trophies at the FCKA 2nd National Karate Championship. Children also take part in the Science Olympiad Foundation's international Olympiads in science, maths, English, general knowledge, computers, social studies and Hindi. [See our events](https://www.kimsindia.com/events/).

### What are the fees?

Please call the school for the current fee details for your child's class.

22 March 2026

KIMS and Kudos children took the stage for Kaleidoscope, the Annual Day on 22 March 2026.

The programme opened with the lighting of the lamp and moved through folk and classical dances, a school band, a Thirukkural recitation in Tamil, a dance about peace and a choir in orange.

It closed with the whole cast on stage together.

![The whole cast on stage for the finale, with sparklers](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/01-800.webp) · ![Teachers and guests light the lamp to open the programme](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/02-800.webp) · ![Children in the school band with tambourines and drums](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/03-800.webp) · ![Children in orange costumes fill the stage](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/04-800.webp) · ![A child recites a Thirukkural couplet in Tamil](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/05-800.webp) · ![A folk dance in white, yellow and orange costumes](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/06-800.webp) · ![Dancers in silver jackets in front of a city-skyline backdrop](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/07-800.webp) · ![Children in hats and braces dance under disco lights](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/08-800.webp) · ![Children in red spell out PEACE on stage](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/09-800.webp) · ![A dance in green and blue costumes](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/10-800.webp) · ![A choir in orange and white sings at the microphones](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/11-800.webp) · ![A village-scene dance in green](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2026/12-800.webp)

1 March 2026 · Sportify Sports Arena

KIMS and Kudos held their Annual Sports Meet on 1 March 2026 at Sportify Sports Arena, Medavakkam.

# Annual Day 2024

> Annual Day 2024 at KIMS Nursery and Primary School, Selaiyur, Chennai, on 3 March 2024. The Annual Day on 3 March 2024 filled the stage with colour, in front of a stained-glass KIMS backdrop.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/events/annual-day-2024/

[All events](https://www.kimsindia.com/events/)

3 March 2024

The Annual Day on 3 March 2024 filled the stage with colour, in front of a stained-glass KIMS backdrop.

Children danced to folk, classical and film songs, drummed, sang in their blue school blazers, and the graduating children received their certificates.

![Children in yellow dance in front of a temple-tower backdrop](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/01-800.webp) · ![The youngest children in yellow perform before the stained-glass KIMS backdrop](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/02-800.webp) · ![Drummers perform on a stage lit in blue](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/03-800.webp) · ![Children in blue blazers line up on stage](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/04-800.webp) · ![Children in blue and yellow perform a dance drama](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/05-800.webp) · ![Children in pink and white dance under neon lights](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/06-800.webp) · ![Girls in afro wigs and pink sequins dance](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/07-800.webp) · ![Graduates sit in rows with their certificates and teachers](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/08-800.webp) · ![A dance in red and black costumes](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/09-800.webp) · ![Children in blue blazers sing on stage](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/10-800.webp) · ![Girls in orange sarees perform a traditional dance](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/11-800.webp) · ![Dancers in red and white under bright stage lights](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/annual-day-2024/12-800.webp)

# Pongal 2024

> Pongal 2024 at KIMS Nursery and Primary School, Selaiyur, Chennai, on 10 January 2024. KIMS celebrated Pongal on 10 January 2024 with a village set: a decorated hut, sugarcane, cows and a Pongal pot.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/events/pongal-2024/

[All events](https://www.kimsindia.com/events/)

10 January 2024

KIMS celebrated Pongal on 10 January 2024 with a village set: a decorated hut, sugarcane, cows and a Pongal pot.

Children came in traditional clothes, drew kolam, danced on the turf and watched a potter shape clay pots.

![Boys in traditional clothes dance on the turf](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/01-800.webp) · ![Girls in pavadai draw a kolam](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/02-800.webp) · ![Children dance with a teacher](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/03-800.webp) · ![Girls dance in traditional dress](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/04-800.webp) · ![Boys and girls in traditional clothes perform a dance](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/05-800.webp) · ![A potter shows children how to shape clay pots](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/06-800.webp) · ![Children watch a dance in the hall](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/07-800.webp) · ![A girl dances as her class watches](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/pongal-2024/08-800.webp)

# Vinayaka Chaturthi 2023

> Vinayaka Chaturthi 2023 at KIMS Nursery and Primary School, Selaiyur, Chennai, on 15 September 2023. Children came in traditional clothes for Vinayaka Chaturthi on 15 September 2023.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/

[All events](https://www.kimsindia.com/events/)

15 September 2023

Children came in traditional clothes for Vinayaka Chaturthi on 15 September 2023.

They brought sweets and offerings from home, placed flowers at the Ganesha altar one by one, and ended the morning with songs and dance in the hall.

![The Vinayaka Chaturthi altar with flowers, sweets and offerings](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/01-800.webp) · ![A teacher arranges the offerings at the Ganesha altar](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/02-800.webp) · ![Sweets and offerings children brought for the festival](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/03-800.webp) · ![Children wait their turn to place flowers at the altar](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/04-800.webp) · ![A child in festive dress waits at the altar](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/05-800.webp) · ![Children in traditional clothes walk up to offer flowers](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/06-800.webp) · ![Boys in veshti dance in the hall](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/07-800.webp) · ![Girls in pavadai at the celebration](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/08-800.webp) · ![Children in festive clothes dance together](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/09-800.webp) · ![Little girls in pattu pavadai at the celebration](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/vinayaka-chaturthi-2023/10-800.webp)

# Karate belt grading 2023

> Karate belt grading 2023 at KIMS Nursery and Primary School, Selaiyur, Chennai, on 21 January 2023. Children in the KIMS karate class were graded on 21 January 2023 and received their new belts and certificates from their instructor.

Source: https://www.kimsindia.com/events/karate-2023/

[All events](https://www.kimsindia.com/events/)

21 January 2023

Children in the KIMS karate class were graded on 21 January 2023 and received their new belts and certificates from their instructor.

Karate builds focus, balance and confidence. KIMS students have also won trophies at the FCKA 2nd National Level Karate Championship.

![The karate class with their certificates and instructors](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/karate-2023/01-800.webp) · ![Instructors in white gi with children in the hall](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/karate-2023/02-800.webp) · ![Children practise karate moves with their instructor](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/karate-2023/03-800.webp) · ![A child receives a certificate and belt from the instructor](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/karate-2023/04-800.webp) · ![Children sit in rows holding certificates and belts](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/karate-2023/05-800.webp) · ![The karate class, instructors and teachers together](https://www.kimsindia.com/assets/img/events/karate-2023/06-800.webp)
